To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the inhibition of adrenergically mediated vascular responses by methionine-enkepahlain and leucine- enkepahlain is impaired in the vascular beds of spontaneously hypertensive rat.

methionine-enkephin (Met-Enk) and leucineenkephalin (Leu-Enk), opioid peptides, inhibited the adrenergically-mediated pressor responses and the norepinephrin (NE) release from the sympathetic nerves, and the inhibition by these peptides was smaller in spontaneously hypertensive (SHR) than in Wistar Kyoto (WKY) rats.
the inhibition of adrenergice transmission by Met-Enkephalin and Leu- Enkephalin is impaired in the vascular bed of spontaneously hypertensive rat.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of the endogenous opioid peptides on the adrengic neurotransmission in SHR.
the effects of methionine and leucine enkephalines (Met-Enk and LEu-Enk respectively) on the adrenegic neurotransmission in spontaneously hypertensive (SHR) rats.
the effects of methionine- or leucine-en-kephalin on adrenergic neuro-transmission in spontaneously hypertensive rat.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the adrenergically mediated vascular responses in the mesenterics of SHR are more enhanced compared to the responses in WKY, but the inhibitory effects of enkepalins on these responses are less effective.
the opioid peptides may play a role in the pathogenesis of hypertension.
enkephaline inhibits adrenergic nerve transmission in hypertension, but the inhibition is impaired in the SHR.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enkephalinergic system may be involved in the development and maintenance of the vascular hypertension in SHR.
the enkephalines may have a role in the pathogenesis of hypertension.
enkephalinergic system is involved in the regulation of adrenergically-mediated vasoconstriction in hypertension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
enkephaline peptides can be used as a therapeutic agent in hypertension, but their efficacy is impaired in spontaneously hypertensive rat models.
enkephaline peptides can be used as a treatment for hypertension.
enkephaline is a potent inhibitor of norepinephrin release in SHR.
